name: niuma-booster
description: 牛马加油器 Windows 桌面版（系统托盘 + 实时工时收入面板）
author: RYKK77

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),{execFileSync}=require('child_process');if(!fs.existsSync('src')){console.log('No src/ directory found; skipping check.');process.exit(0);}const files=fs.readdirSync('src',{recursive:true}).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).map(f=>path.join('src',f)).filter(f=>fs.statSync(f).isFile());for(const f of files){try{execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});}catch(e){process.exit(e.status?e.status:1);}}console.log('Syntax OK: '+files.length+' file(s)');"
